snippet.title: AVO: Echoes of the Void
snippet.description:
What if moving was the challenge?

AVO: Echoes of the Void is a VR puzzle experience set inside a drifting spacecraft, where you navigate in full zero gravity.

Early players are already saying:
“Very fun to get familiar with the zero gravity movement”
“The atmosphere is deeply immersive”
“Challenging puzzles in a spaceship”

🚀 Launching March 26, 2026 on Meta Quest

👉 Wishlist / Get it here: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/avo-echoes-of-the-void/26128591396807449/?srsltid=AfmBOooKrKOaK0MLDY75HSNnDCuL0DCdxt2lmvNG277Lr7GRvMB3kJ7E
